details.description: This is Fireworks AI's BF16 (full-precision) deployment of Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct, Qwen's largest coding-specialized model: a mixture-of-experts model with 480 billion total parameters and 35 billion activated per token (160 experts, 8 active), released July 22, 2025. Qwen built it for agentic coding, agentic browser-use, and agentic tool-use, with repository-scale code understanding, and its launch blog describes results on these tasks among open models as 'comparable to Claude Sonnet 4.' It runs in non-thinking mode only, per Qwen's model card.
advantages: Scores 38.7 on SWE-bench Pro's public dataset, a software-engineering benchmark (Scale AI's SWE-bench Pro leaderboard, for the underlying model).
Qwen's launch blog describes its results on Agentic Coding, Agentic Browser-Use, and Agentic Tool-Use as 'comparable to Claude Sonnet 4' among open models.
Served in BF16 (full) precision on Fireworks AI, rather than a lower-precision quantized format.
Integrates with Qwen Code and Cline for IDE-based agentic coding workflows.
disadvantages: Non-thinking mode only; does not generate <think></think> reasoning blocks (Qwen's model card).
480B total parameters (35B active) require substantial compute to serve, especially at full BF16 precision.
use_cases: Autonomous coding agents for multi-step software development tasks
Agentic browser-use tasks driven by a coding agent
Tool-calling and function-calling workflows via OpenAI-compatible APIs

notes: Fireworks' model page for this exact ID (qwen3-coder-480b-instruct-bf16) confirms it as 'The BF16 version of the 480B coder model', referencing Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct on Hugging Face as the same base model, and states a 262k-token context length there. Catalog facts for this target, however, give max_input/max_output of only 4,096 tokens, a large conflict with both Qwen's native 262,144-token spec and Fireworks' own page copy; per instructions the catalog value is kept and no specific context-length figure is restated in the description. This may reflect a smaller context cap Fireworks actually enforces on this particular (unquantized) BF16 deployment versus its other Qwen3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct listing, but that could not be confirmed on any page opened. Verification pass: the HF card for the underlying model has no benchmark table at all (no model-index, no scores in the README), so both evaluation entries as originally sourced were unsupported. SWE-bench Pro 38.7 was independently confirmed on Scale AI's public leaderboard for 'qwen3-coder-480b-a35b' and re-sourced there; Terminal-Bench 2.0 23.9 could not be confirmed on any current or archived page and was removed.
